{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing = df.isnull().sum()
print(missing)

# Check value counts for 'arm'
print('\nArm value counts:')
print(df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check value counts for 'responded'
print('\nResponded value counts:')
print(df['responded'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline (e.g., -999):')
print(df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]['biomarker_baseline'].count())"}
